title: Forklift Operator/ Pick Pack
summary:
We’re Hiring: Forklift Operator/Pick Packer | Woodridge
Day Shift | Start ASAP | Ongoing Work

Join a recognised company that’s growing like crazy! We’re on the lookout for skilled Counter balance Forklift Operators to jump into an awesome team based in Woodridge.

 Shift: Monday to Friday, 8:30am – 5:30pm
 $37.00 per hour 
 PPE Required: Hi-vis (vest or polo), steel caps – standard safety gear

 ✅ What You’ll Need:
- Current Forklift Licence
- At least 12 months' forklift experience 
- Warehousing and pick packing experience
- Physically fit - The goods can vary in weight 
- A good team vibe – you'll be working closely with others

✅ What You’ll Be Doing:
- Driving counter balance
- Picking and packing orders
- Loading/Unloading 
- Being part of a tight-knit AMAZING crew

✅ Perks of the Job:
- $37.00 rate
- Easy location in Southside with free onsite parking
- Great team with good laughs, straightforward picking process
- Casual to perm opportunities for the right candidate
- In-house promotions - Our client will always look to promote within before  outsourcing. This allows individuals to grow and thrive.  

We’re screening now – don’t wait!
Reach out for a confidential chat and lock in your next opportunity.
